title: Remove Dummy Non Existing Folder Sprawl
description: Stop vite elementsAssets closeBundle from creating cad/js/renderer/play/dummy-non-existing-folder copies of ui/assets; remove sprawl and harden plugin.
summary: The `dummy-non-existing-folder` trees were accidental copies of `ui/assets` created by `elementsAssetsVitePlugin` `closeBundle` when Vite used a non-`dist` `build.outDir` (e.g. `--outDir dummy-non-existing-folder`). Split the plugin into serve vs build-only hooks, always copy assets to `<viteRoot>/dist/assets`, spread plugins in all play vite configs, pin `outDir: dist` on cad renderer play, fix Nx `cwd` to `cad/js/renderer`, and remove the stray folder.
